metadata.description: Cross-platform streams that shared customers run across several Katapull platforms.

streams.name: Sell and Deliver an Order from Any Channel
streams.description: An order placed in a Highbiza webshop, on a marketplace via EffectConnect or in a Vendit store reaches the commerce core, is picked in Picqer or Logic4 and shipped with DeliveryMatch, with stock and status flowing back to every channel.
